title: Migrate a 5,000-line generated API client to its v2 surface, rule by rule
prompt:
client.py in the current directory is our generated Harbor API client (about 5,000 lines, one method per endpoint). The generator is gone, so the file has to be migrated in place to the v2 surface that MIGRATION.md describes: all six rules, applied to every method of Client, with the per-method exceptions listed in its table. Methods the rules do not touch must keep working exactly as they do now.

tests/test_client.py has examples of the v2 behaviour for a few methods; run them from this directory with `/usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. More tests than these check every method and every rule.

Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only. Do not modify MIGRATION.md or tests/test_client.py.
